pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Catholic Primary School - Music and The Arts
pageCache.text:
Music and The Arts
In February of 2025 we received the ArtsMark at silver level from the Arts Council this award recognises our achievement as a whole school to foster creativity in our school community across music and the arts. At St Mary’s, we believe that studying Music and The Arts within a rich and challenging curriculum, deepens learning and develops the whole child, as a confident resilient learner.
The Arts are embedded throughout our curriculum and at St Mary’s children have experience of Art and Design in every year to understand what it is that artists, designers and crafts workers do, and to develop their own confidence in using media and techniques.
Through Drama, we enable pupils to express their thoughts, ideas and feelings. As they progress through the Key Stages, they become more self-confident and self-aware. At the same time, they develop their understanding about the world around, learning to interact with others in creative ways.
At St Mary’s, children have many opportunities to sing in choirs, performing in Singing Festivals, The Young Voices Concert at The O2 Arena, in the local community and as part of our Liturgical events throughout the year. Children also have opportunities to learn a variety of musical instruments in Key Stage One and Key Stage Two, such as: Ocarina, Recorder, Djembe, Guitar, Clarinet, Ukulele, Brass and Keyboard, performing in group and whole-class ensembles.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Catholic Primary School - Wraparound Care
pageCache.text:
Wraparound Care
St Mary’s offers children from Reception to Year 6 a safe, welcoming start and relaxing end to the school day with our morning and afternoon sessions. Our morning session begins at 7:30am when your child is met and registered at the school gate by a member of staff.
A nutritious breakfast is offered, comprising of a choice of healthy cereals, toast with a variety of toppings, a choice of diluted fruit juices, water and milk.
Sessions run from 7:30 – 8:45am (Monday – Friday) and cost £4.50 per day.
Afternoon sessions run from 3:30pm – 6:00pm (Monday – Friday) and cost £10.00 per day. Your child will go to the hall-base at the end of the school day and be registered by a member of staff.
A nutritious snack will be served, comprising of a choice of healthy sandwich fillings, a piece of fruit or a yoghurt, and diluted juice or water.
Children are not permitted to bring their own food to any of the sessions as we have a number of children with allergies. Where possible we will provide for additional dietary needs.
Places for both sessions are limited and we strongly recommend you pre-book and pay for your child’s place as they are allocated on a first come, first served basis. Payment is essential at the time of booking to secure your child’s place. If you need to cancel a morning booking you must notify us by 3:30pm the day before your booking and 12:00pm on the day of an afternoon booking, to be able to receive a refund.
Please book via Arbor. If you are unable to book your selected date, the session will be full.
Wraparound Care is supervised by Mrs Allcorn , Mrs Maybourne, Mr Francis and Mrs Rumianceva

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Catholic Primary School - PE and School Sport
pageCache.text:
PE and School Sport
At St Mary’s, we give pupils the opportunities to experience a range of sports and activities so that every child can become confident and competent in a range of physical activities. Children are encouraged to enjoy both indoor and outdoor exercise, valuing the importance of a healthy active lifestyle.
School Sports Partnerships
St Mary’s is linked with the Greenacre Sports Partnerships. The teams from the Partnership support the teaching of PE within the school and also provide us with opportunities to participate in a variety of sporting events throughout the school year.
We receive access to:
Teacher support with planning and delivering lessons
Local inter-school sports competitions
Sports Coordinator support for in-school events
Curriculum planning and assessment resources
Health and safety advice
Links to local ‘club marked’ sports clubs
Annual Young Leader training of 20+ pupils

pageCache.pageTitle: St Mary's Catholic Primary School - Core Values
pageCache.text:
Core Values
St Mary’s is a two form entry school serving the Parish of Our Lady of Gillingham within the Diocese of Southwark. We are part of the Medway Local Authority. The primary purpose of the school is to provide an education in a Catholic environment which will provide each pupil with an equal opportunity to experience the love of God, to understand their role and responsibilities in school and in the Catholic and wider communities. Central to everything that we do at St Mary’s is the Catholic ethos whereby all members of the school community are valued - children, parents, staff, governors, visitors etc.
Our school values have been encapsulated into 4 themes:
Respect God
Respect each other
Be responsible
Take pride in our school.
